appraisal_events.evidence: « je ne pus retenir ma colère et lui reprochai son ingratitude : « Oui, vous pouvez demander à tout le monde, criai-je de toutes mes forces, hors de moi... » »
appraisal_events.explanation: In this staged confrontation with Albertine, the in-scene narrator loses composure and shouts at her, an admitted lapse of self-mastery distinct from the already-scored diminishment of Albertine.

status_effects.explanation: His outburst of anger, described as being 'hors de moi', marks a momentary loss of emotional control in his staged interaction with Albertine.
